Sam: quick check — inc-912 postmortem: can we confirm final owners for the action items? I listed tentative owners in the doc but want cross-team ack
Priya: saw the doc, thanks. I'm ok to own A1 (rollback test flakiness) and A3 (helm values audit) 
Ken: I can take A2 (routing policy fallback) but timeline depends on eng-sre bandwidth next week
Marta: FYI I already started the PR for A3, small changes left — pinging @Liz for review :pray:
Liz: thanks @Marta — I can review tomorrow morning. @Sam can you add the PR link to the postmortem? makes traceability easier
Sam: added link: https://git.redwood/infer/postmortems/912/changes — also added a short `action_items.md` section with owners/due dates
Jules: quick Q — are due dates fixed? we put 2025-01-14 for A1 but eng-oncall suggested sooner if possible
Priya: I can move A1 up to 2025-01-10 if Ken can start the integration tests by Thu
Ken: I can start Thu afternoon. set A1 to 2025-01-10 for now. if blocked I'll post in #eng-oncall
Marta: A3 target stays 2025-01-17, but PR link is ready: https://git.redwood/infra/helm/pulls/432 
Liz: reviewing now, will leave comments inline. small nits only, expect to approve today :thumbsup:
Sam: can we also confirm who will own the follow-up for the Dedicated capacity telemetry alert (A4)? it's cross-team with eng-sre and infra
Priya: I nominate @Jules to coordinate — you have context from the canary right?
Jules: I can coordinate A4 but will need a co-owner from eng-sre. tagging @Ken as probable contact
Ken: happy to co-own A4 for eng-sre side, will set up a short sync (15m) Fri 10:00 PT — calendar invite incoming
DeployBot: deploy notice — postmortem doc updated by Sam at 2025-01-04T16:22:00Z
Sam: thanks all. final ask: please add a single-line ack in the doc under your owner row ("ack by <name> <date>") so we can close the postmortem checklist
Liz: ack by Liz 2025-01-04
Priya: ack by Priya 2025-01-04
Ken: ack by Ken 2025-01-04
Marta: ack by Marta 2025-01-04
Jules: ack by Jules 2025-01-04 — will follow up after Fri sync with eng-sre notes
Sam: perfect. if anything slips, please update the due date in the doc instead of changing owners. thanks everyone :v:
